question: South Carolina State hung 87 on Savannah State: does that firepower survive its first real test at Florida A&M this week?

stances.renee-vaughn: MODERATOR: take NO side; referee and press both debaters on whether South Carolina State's offense can replicate its dominance against a tougher Florida A&M defense.
stances.cassius-wynn: YES, South Carolina State's 87-point explosion shows real offensive firepower that will survive the test against Florida A&M because their offense dominated with strong protection and scoring ability even if the competition steps up.
stances.andrew-hammond: NO, South Carolina State's huge score against Savannah State won't survive the test at Florida A&M because the previous opponent was weak and the game will be a completely different challenge.
